facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the dog park is like paradise for her dogs, as they love socializing with other pups and getting exercise.

evidence.quote: The dog park is like paradise for them! They love socializing with the other pups and getting lots of exercise.

facts.text: Audrey described her dogs as enjoying running around and smelling things at the dog park.

evidence.quote: It's so cute to watch them running around and smelling all the stuff.

facts.text: Andrew shared a funny story about his dog chasing a squirrel at the dog park, which resulted in the squirrel watching from the branches.

evidence.quote: There was this one time my pup got too excited and chased a squirrel. He ran around the tree and the squirrel just watched from the branches. It was hilarious!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that her dogs hate snow and were confused during a visit to a snowy dog park last winter.

evidence.quote: I took them to a snowy one last winter and they were so confused! They definitely prefer nice, sunny days in the grass.
